articles.title: What Happens To Synopsys Stock If AI Learns To Design Chips Without It?
articles.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) sells the electronic design automation software and design IP that chipmakers use to build new chips. Its stock has lost 16.3% over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained 18.5%.
